title: Insecure TLS certificates will be ‘a massive cleanup job’ for system admins.
summary: Cryptography engineer Filippo Valsorda told Ars that the number of affected devices means it’ll take longer to clean up than Heartbleed , an infamous OpenSSL vulnerability that rocked the internet in 2014 and took years to fix.
